question: E4: why did the release-gate Battleship run (Claude Sonnet, 2.9.0 marketplace, engine done) fail checks 3 and 4?
finding: a harness false fail: the product commits page.html and server.js reads it at start (fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'page.html'))); check 2 runs `curl ... -o page.html && grep ...; rm -f page.html` in work/, so it overwrote and then deleted the product's own file, and every later check's server died with ENOENT. The product repository was left with ' D page.html'.

regrade.method: work/ copied to a scratch folder, page.html restored with git checkout, checks run one by one through run.run_checks on the wave 1 branch
regrade.after: page.html deleted again by the shipped check 2

not_covered_by: CheckHygieneTest.test_checks_leave_no_untracked_file_behind keeps a file whose name no check uses

fixed_regrade.method: the same copy, page.html restored, the four battleship checks as the fix writes them (page piped from a variable, node --test to mktemp, check 4 battleship_game.py), all in one run_checks call as a live run makes it

fix: 12 check and retention lines now write scratch output to mktemp or a shell variable; CheckScratchFileTest scans every line and runs them all against a product that commits page.html and the scratch names (53 failures on the old cases.json, 0 on the new)
